prompt: extreme close-up macro photograph, 100mm macro lens, razor-sharp focal plane. The mechanism is off-centre on the right thirds, with the background falling away into deep, atmospheric shadow. Shallow depth of field, visible surface dust and metallic texture, soft directional golden-hour daylight casting long shadows across the tactile paper stock and polished silicon. Refined editorial cover standard, quiet tension.
